tasks.userFacingSummary: Sync journal: capture triggers never break writes, migrations or renames
Sync journal A: trigger suspension never cascade-deletes rows during a table rebuild
Vault pull attaches a NEW replica for the same device each time (project lists duplicate replicas per device)
Every cleo CLI call peaks at about 440 MB RSS, even cleo --version
darwin admission has no memory-pressure signal: the governor cannot refuse heavy work while swap is nearly full
Build Wave 7.5 emits three core files as self-contained esbuild bundles that inline contracts and part of core, duplicating core singletons and zod schemas
Heavy admission counts runs, not footprint: one whole-suite evidence run holds the single darwin test slot for 15+ minutes while single-file test runs from every other agent starve behind it
Nested admission deadlocks: a cleo verify or cleo run started under cleo run waits for the governor slot its own parent holds; CLEO needs one lock order and re-entrant admission
Agent instructions: one governed path for tests, typechecks and builds; never override heap caps; prefer targeted and affected evidence
gh#1805: evidence scoping treats .opencode/** runtime state and untracked files as workspace-wide source, forcing full-suite evidence
Installed CLEO never learns a fix is available: no passive update notice, so hotfixes reach only users who run cleo self-update
Flaky: affected-packages.test.ts 'an INLINE project object...' gets {ok:false, busy:true} under contention and fails main CI
janitor estimateProcessStartMs splits /proc/<pid>/stat on spaces without skipping comm, so an MCP process named 'npm exec @playw' loses its grace period
A deferred exodus-on-open leaves an empty, writable store; the first write strands the legacy data. Refuse writes (like exodusAbort) or wait boundedly
Split CLI chunks can vanish under a long-running cleo process after an in-place upgrade (npm i -g / cleo self-update), so its next lazy import fails
Evidence integrity: a change can declare evidence.scopeExcludes that drop its own code from scope; an empty filtered diff then passes vacuously
cleo changeset add writes summaries containing ': ' unquoted, producing invalid YAML front matter that fails CI
A failed mutation writes no audit_log row: the audit middleware's fire-and-forget write dies when the CLI calls process.exit on the error path
cleo current, briefing and session status still load the core barrel or session/hooks graph (current ~147 MB; briefing and session status 310-330 MB)
An aborted exodus-on-open (parity failure, assessment failure, plan mismatch, marker with legacy rows) still leaves an empty, writable store; extend the T13158 guard to kind 'aborted'
Stop defaulting to api.signaldock.io: no cleo code path makes a network call to a SignalDock host (fails clearly or no-ops); fix 'cleo conduit peek' acking what it reads
darwin: load average read as CPU pressure still defers other db-heavy work (sentient tick, so the dream trigger never fires); decide whether load average should gate db-heavy at all
T13158 follow-ups: a guard error inside the lease fails open; the anchor-keyed lift opens other tables while their source still copies; deferred wording kept after an abort
superseded-store --reconcile silently skips a legacy task whose id was reused after a deferred exodus, and still reports every row present
Evidence for a merged PR that edits ci.yml falls back to a local whole-suite tool:test, lint and typecheck
cleo release reconcile fails E_PROVENANCE_FAILED (UNIQUE tasks_releases.version) when a planned row for the version already exists
Canary releases via OIDC only: publish X-rc.N to canary, soak, then publish X to latest; drop the NPM_TOKEN dist-tag promotion
Recovered legacy tasks keep their remap durably (display alias), so a rename before a second reconcile does not recover them again
Hotfix flag for the update notice comes from package metadata written at publish time, not a manual npm dist-tag
Gate 38 follows destructured dynamic imports (const { x } = await import(...)) so lazy mutation handlers stay in sync-write coverage
macOS main CI never completes: cancel-in-progress cancels every run when merges land faster than ~50 minutes
Ledger re-entrancy: require the token hint when a holder's start time is unknown
Evidence tool runner has no test-environment guard: a stale mock let tool:test spawn pnpm run test from inside vitest, recursing into whole suites
cleo doctor reports old CLEO entries in the user-global Claude settings (report-only, never writes)
Remove the claude-code adapter's user-global ~/.claude/settings.json hook writer (registerNativeHooks/registerPreCompactHook)
Tests run with foreign keys OFF: getDb disables FKs under VITEST, hiding cascade and SET NULL behaviour
Observe-time embed writes brain_embeddings outside the chokepoint when a host falls back inline (#1871 MED)
cleo run refuses whole-suite test runs by accident: a vitest with no file/project/filter arg, and any test/build spawn from inside a test runner
Core SDK installAgent/installAllAgents symlink into user-global ~/.claude/agents (CLAUDE_HOME)
Observe-time embed: test a writer-isolate flag, not !isMainThread
syncWorkerCleoDir: gate on the writer-isolate flag, not isMainThread
CAAMP injectAll and caamp instructions inject/update refuse a $HOME project; cleo init/upgrade at ~ report it
Store restore (and vault restore) race: a process opening cleo.db between the final quiescence check and the rename writes a WAL against the replaced file (#1902 MED)
Legacy JSON import (migrateJsonToSqlite) fails under foreign keys: tasks reference sessions and later tasks before they exist
cleo run whole-suite guard: pnpm -r/--filter test must read each matched package's test script; drop casts in packageScript
Whole-suite guard: an exclusion-only pnpm filter (--filter '!foo') selects every other package and must be refused; strip quotes from script words
Contracts default PR_REQUIRED_WORKFLOWS names checks CLEO never ships (Lockfile Check, Contracts Dep Lint): fix the default, pin it to the shipped templates
cleo login with no TTY or in an agent session defaults to the Nexus device flow; login nexus links an unambiguous project without --yes when non-interactive
cloud verify re-downloads and sha256-checks snapshot blobs (opt-in --deep), re-hashes journal segments, points to backup verify for local backups
Strip terminal control sequences from server-supplied strings in cloud human output

meta.releaseNotes:
## v2026.10.5 — 2026-10-07

> **Update now: run `cleo self-update`.** This release ships releases through a canary first, makes `cleo login` the one setup step on a new machine, and fixes a regression that let a second full build run beside the first.

### Highlights

- **Releases go through a canary before `latest` (#1847).** Each stable version is first published as a release candidate under npm's `canary` tag, installed from npm into a throwaway sandbox and health-checked. Only then is it published to `latest`, all through OIDC with no npm token. A failed soak leaves users on the previous release. Try a candidate with `npm i -g @cleocode/cleo@canary`.
- **`cleo login` is the one setup step (#1939).** After you sign in, `cleo login` links the project you are in and takes its first encrypted backup, or lists your cloud projects on a new machine. `cleo cloud verify --deep` downloads the snapshots again and re-hashes them (#1947), and output that shows server-supplied names strips terminal control characters (#1958).
- **CLEO tells you when an update is out.** An installed CLEO prints a notice on stderr when a newer release exists, and a hotfix gets a stronger notice (#1840, #1849).
- **Less work at startup and in tests.** More CLI commands start without loading the whole core library (#1855, #1859, #1868, T13126), and test runs started through CLEO refuse to grow into a whole-suite run (T13203, T13236).

### Also in this release

- **One full build machine-wide again** (#1899, T13237): fixes the P0 regression from #1865 where a second full build could start beside the first.
- **Backups**: the global store gets backups and restore, backups restore onto the live `cleo.db` (#1917, T13245, T13286), and the global-backup lock now outlasts a blocking `VACUUM INTO` (#1948, T13293).
- **Cloud**: presence refreshes during normal CLI use, hourly and best-effort with no daemon (#1942, T13289); `cloud status` and `cloud projects show` list the devices holding a project (#1943, T13290); `cleo project link` registers a new project with its v1 key once the matching cleo-nexus release is live (#1795, T13101).
- **Init and upgrade**: the adapter install step that never ran is removed (#1883, T13128).
- **CI and release tooling**: arch gates, lint workflows, Lockfile Check and the changeset lint now run inside required CI, so a failing gate blocks the merge (#1929, #1930, #1932, #1937; T13263, T13279, T13281); PR unit shards run the changed packages and their dependents (#1821, T13142); darwin PRs run 2 macOS shards and macOS Build & Verify gets a 20-minute timeout (#1822, #1866, #1869; T13143, T13198, T13205); flaky tests are re-run once, then filed and quarantined (#1819, T13145); `ci:<pr>` evidence accepts the jobs that cover a PR's changed paths (#1844, T13175); gate 36 compares migrations with the merge-base (#1951, T13294); checkouts are blobless with 5-minute lint timeouts (#1971, T13310).
- **Sync journal work** (Stage C: change journal, apply/rebase, genesis cut, push/pull and related fixes) is merged but ships flag-gated and off by default: `sync.seal`, `sync.push`, `sync.pull` and `sync.strict` stay in UNRELEASED_FLAGS.

### Added

- cleo cloud verify --deep downloads the snapshots again and re-hashes their bytes and the journal tail _(provenance: [T13291](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13291&type=commits))_
- cleo doctor sync-triggers reports triggers that reference a missing table or column, and --repair fixes what CLEO owns _(provenance: [T12754](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12754&type=commits))_
- An installed CLEO announces a newer release on stderr, and a release planned as a hotfix gets a stronger notice every 15 minutes _(provenance: [T13137](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13137&type=commits))_
- A stable release reaches npm latest only after its release candidate installs from npm and passes a sandbox soak, all through OIDC with no npm token _(provenance: [T13144](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13144&type=commits), [T13181](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13181&type=commits))_
- A hotfix is flagged in @cleocode/cleo's published manifest by release.yml, from the plan's releaseKind, instead of a manual npm dist-tag _(provenance: [T13184](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13184&type=commits))_

### Changed

- Every agent surface (CLEO-INJECTION.md, ct-cleo, the spawn prompt) now gives one governed path for tests, typechecks and builds: cleo run --wait --class, never a wrapper around cleo run or cleo verify, never raising heap or worker counts, targeted evidence over whole suites _(provenance: [T13134](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13134&type=commits))_
- Store tests now run with foreign keys ON, as production does; getDb no longer turns them off under vitest, and fixtures that seed out of FK order opt out explicitly with optOutOfForeignKeys(). _(provenance: [T13228](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13228&type=commits))_

### Fixed

- Cloud human output strips terminal control sequences from server-supplied names and messages _(provenance: [T13295](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13295&type=commits))_
- Exodus copies each legacy source inside a rule-1 capture bracket and marks the sync set suspect; the bracket applies rule 2 to declared rebuilds, so a parent rebuild no longer cascade-deletes its children _(provenance: [T12785](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12785&type=commits), [T12774](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12774&type=commits))_
- A vault pull or restore now retires this store's replica as a vault restore and records it for S4; cloud status, projects show and restore name the retired replicas _(provenance: [T13109](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13109&type=commits))_
- cleo dash, stats and the other admin commands load about 640-970 modules and ~150 MB instead of ~3,000 and ~260 MB _(provenance: [T13126](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13126&type=commits))_
- cleo memory observe drops from ~710 MB to ~315 MB; no worker isolate or embedding model in one-shot commands _(provenance: [T13126](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13126&type=commits))_
- Runtime code imports contracts values from their leaf modules, so a store open no longer loads every contracts zod schema _(provenance: [T13126](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13126&type=commits))_
- verify, deps, tree, orchestrate, memory find, docs, nexus and doctor no longer load all of CORE; ~115-225 MB instead of ~255-280 MB _(provenance: [T13126](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13126&type=commits))_
- cleo check arch no longer demands a full build; gate 39 skips locally without a current build and CI enforces it _(provenance: [T13126](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13126&type=commits))_
- cleo show, find, list and current dispatch without loading the CORE barrel _(provenance: [T13126](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13126&type=commits))_
- cleo show, find, list and current load about 450 modules and ~135 MB instead of ~820 and ~190 MB _(provenance: [T13126](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13126&type=commits))_
- Opening a store reads and hashes each migration lineage once, not about a dozen times _(provenance: [T13126](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13126&type=commits))_
- cleo add, update and other mutations no longer fetch models.dev on every call; cleo config get ~120 MB instead of ~250 MB _(provenance: [T13126](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13126&type=commits))_
- Every cleo command loads less; cleo --version drops to 64 modules and about 55 MB _(provenance: [T13126](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13126&type=commits))_
- cleo add, update, start, complete, next and focus no longer load all of CORE; ~150-240 MB instead of ~260-295 MB _(provenance: [T13126](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13126&type=commits))_
- macOS memory pressure is now visible to admission: the darwin backend grades a kernel warning by RAM squeeze and swap and scores running out of headroom in absolute bytes, so the existing budget narrowing and cleo run's pause at backoff finally act on a Mac whose swap is nearly full, without flagging laptops that merely carry old swap _(provenance: [T13127](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13127&type=commits))_
- Core's utils-consuming dist files are emitted per file again, so a process holds one copy of each core module _(provenance: [T13129](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13129&type=commits))_
- A whole-suite run no longer takes the whole machine budget: heavy runs plan for half of it, every run is charged what its plan lets it start, a single-file test run takes one worker's share, CPU saturation narrows only heavy runs, and status marks whole-suite runs with their project and task _(provenance: [T13132](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13132&type=commits))_
- One admission ledger replaces the tool semaphore's slots, the governor's test/build/full-build slots, cleo run's per-class queues and the darwin one-slot rule: every heavy run shares one machine-wide memory budget and one FIFO queue, a run nested in an admitted run rides its admission (verified by process ancestry, not an env var), and a waiter blocked for a minute names the holders and any suspected wait cycle _(provenance: [T13133](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13133&type=commits))_
- Evidence scoping ignores CLEO's own hook files and project-declared runtime state, so they no longer force a full suite _(provenance: [T13135](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13135&type=commits))_
- The janitor reads a process's start time correctly when its name contains spaces, so an MCP server titled by npm keeps its grace period _(provenance: [T13146](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13146&type=commits))_
- A deferred migration from the legacy stores can no longer strand their data _(provenance: [T13158](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13158&type=commits))_
- A long-running cleo command that outlives an in-place upgrade keeps its exit code instead of crashing after its work is done; CLI chunk names may use any case _(provenance: [T13159](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13159&type=commits))_
- when the CLI cannot load the code that finishes a command, it prints the upgrade/reinstall notice only for a genuinely missing module, and any other load error as itself _(provenance: [T13159](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13159&type=commits))_
- cleo changeset add now quotes a summary that is not a plain YAML scalar (colon-space, quotes, backticks, newlines) and parses the rendered file back before writing, so it can no longer write a changeset the changeset lint rejects. _(provenance: [T13163](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13163&type=commits))_
- A failed mutation now writes its audit_log row, and the CLI's error exits no longer kill pending hook writes or buffered telemetry _(provenance: [T13164](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13164&type=commits))_
- cleo briefing loads ~710 modules and ~190 MB instead of ~3,000 and ~260 MB; cleo session status ~175 MB instead of ~320 MB _(provenance: [T13166](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13166&type=commits))_
- An aborted migration from the legacy stores can no longer strand their data _(provenance: [T13167](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13167&type=commits))_
- No CLEO code path calls a SignalDock host any more (SignalDock is retired), and cleo conduit peek no longer acks the messages it shows _(provenance: [T13169](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13169&type=commits))_
- A busy CPU no longer defers the sentient tick or other db-heavy work; the governor budgets every class but heavy test and build runs on memory pressure alone _(provenance: [T13170](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13170&type=commits))_
- The exodus write guard lifts per legacy source, so no table takes writes while its own copy is pending; a store no trigger can guard refuses the open (E_EXODUS_GUARD_FAILED); a deferral that ended in an abort refuses as the abort _(provenance: [T13171](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13171&type=commits))_
- superseded-store --reconcile recovers a legacy task whose id a newer task took, instead of silently skipping it _(provenance: [T13172](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13172&type=commits))_
- A merged PR that edits a CI workflow is attested by main's push CI; cleo done no longer plans a local whole-suite run for it _(provenance: [T13174](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13174&type=commits))_
- cleo release reconcile completes the existing release row for the version instead of failing on UNIQUE tasks_releases.version _(provenance: [T13176](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13176&type=commits))_
- A legacy task the reconcile recovered stays recovered after you retitle it, and cleo show <legacy id> says where it went _(provenance: [T13183](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13183&type=commits))_
- The main-push macOS run is no longer cancelled by the next push, so main gets a macOS verdict; release open names the newest main commit with a green macOS run _(provenance: [T13187](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13187&type=commits))_
- A run nested under an admitted run whose start time was never recorded rides its admission only with the holder's token _(provenance: [T13188](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13188&type=commits))_
- the evidence tool runner refuses to start a tool from inside a test runner _(provenance: [T13203](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13203&type=commits))_
- cleo doctor reports what an old CLEO left in the user-global Claude settings, with the manual removal steps; it never edits that file _(provenance: [T13221](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13221&type=commits))_
- the Claude Code adapter writes its hooks, plugin enable and hook scripts to the project's .claude/ only and can no longer write the user-global ~/.claude/settings.json _(provenance: [T13227](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13227&type=commits))_
- a project rooted at your home directory no longer gets CLEO's instruction block in ~/CLAUDE.md, ~/AGENTS.md or another provider instruction file, which providers load into every session under $HOME _(provenance: [T13227](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13227&type=commits))_
- cleo doctor also finds hand-written CLEO safestop hooks and says "no matcher" when an entry has none; cloud status counts this replica's folded transactions in the last sealed seq _(provenance: [T13221](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13221&type=commits), [T12998](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T12998&type=commits))_
- cleo run refuses a whole-suite test run nobody asked for (a vitest run naming nothing, an empty or '.' filter, or pnpm test) unless --whole-suite, and refuses to start anything inside a test runner (exit 8) _(provenance: [T13236](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13236&type=commits))_
- cleo restore backup --snapshot <file> | --id <backupId> restores the live cleo.db safely; --file tasks.db no longer reports a restore that wrote a file nothing reads _(provenance: [T13240](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13240&type=commits), [T13258](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13258&type=commits))_
- the core agent installer links a project's agents into the project's .claude/agents and can no longer write the user-global ~/.claude/agents _(provenance: [T13241](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13241&type=commits))_
- backup recover and restore-by-id now restore the live cleo.db; the global store gets backups and a restore path; backup add writes one cleo.db copy _(provenance: [T13245](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13245&type=commits), [T13258](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13258&type=commits), [T13286](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13286&type=commits))_
- only the brain writer isolate writes an observe-time embedding directly; any other worker thread goes through the chokepoint _(provenance: [T13246](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13246&type=commits), [T13230](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13230&type=commits))_
- only the brain writer isolate re-points CLEO_DIR to each op's project; other worker threads keep their own _(provenance: [T13251](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13251&type=commits), [T13246](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13246&type=commits))_
- cleo init/upgrade, caamp instructions inject/update and CAAMP injectAll no longer write project instruction files in your home directory; Cursor's hooks are skipped there too _(provenance: [T13257](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13257&type=commits))_

- The legacy JSON import (cleo upgrade from todo.json) no longer fails tasks whose provenance session, parent or dependency comes later in the files; it runs in one transaction with foreign keys deferred, and drops every dangling reference with a warning naming it. _(provenance: [T13259](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13259&type=commits))_
- cleo run's whole-suite guard reads each matched workspace package's test script for pnpm -r / --filter, and follows a root script that delegates to them _(provenance: [T13277](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13277&type=commits), [T13241](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13241&type=commits))_
- cleo run's whole-suite guard follows pnpm's filter semantics for exclusions (--filter '!foo' selects every other package) and strips quotes inside package scripts _(provenance: [T13280](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13280&type=commits))_
- the built-in required-check list is cleocode's real gates (CI, Contracts Dep Lint); it no longer names Lockfile Check, a check that never reported _(provenance: [T13285](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13285&type=commits))_
- cleo login alone signs an agent in to Cleo Nexus and links the project; it no longer falls into the LLM-provider error without a terminal _(provenance: [T13288](https://github.com/kryptobaseddev/cleo/search?q=T13288&type=commits))_
